findings.detail: The extracted identifier stores spread 6.90%, but the matching source schedule row shows spread 6.75% for the same issuer, instrument, floor, coupon, and maturity.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The flagged identifier names FSK Pallet Holding Corp. (Kamps), First Lien Term Loan, SOFR(Q), floor 1.25%, spread 6.90%, total coupon 10.83%, maturity 12/23/2026. Raw source table 20 row 22 matches the issuer, instrument, ref, floor, total coupon, and maturity, but its Spread column is 6.75%, not 6.90%. The source therefore grounds a localized extraction defect rather than a false alarm.
